subject: Authorization & access governance — Launch plan for Fieldbridge onboarding
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Liu <alice.liu@fieldbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Authorization & access governance — Launch plan for Fieldbridge onboarding

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our scope, we want to lock down the access plan for your production tenant before the next staging cutover. High-level goals:
- SSO (SAML) configured with attribute mapping for groups & role claim
- SCIM provisioning for user + group sync (minimal write scope)
- IP allowlist for admin consoles and restricted callbacks
- Dedicated service account for background ingestion jobs (rotate credentials monthly)

I attached a compact checklist and a SAML metadata stub to get us started. Can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday so we can schedule the first engineering handoff next week?
1) Primary IdP entity ID and ACS URL for Fieldbridge (or test IdP metadata)
2) Team owning SCIM changes and expected attribute fields (email, displayName, title, groups)
3) CIDR ranges we should allow for callback endpoints and admin UI (we can start with placeholder ranges and tighten later)

If helpful, Ben can run through a short SCIM attribute mapping call with your directory engineer — do you have a 30-min slot next Tuesday?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: SAML_Metadata_Fieldbridge.xml, scim-attribute-mapping.csv

From: Alice Liu <alice.liu@fieldbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fieldbridge.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization & access governance — Launch plan for Fieldbridge onboarding

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail we need. Quick answers inline:
1) Our IdP is Okta. I attached our test metadata (see separate email to security inbox) and the ACS will be https://app.fieldbridge.com/sso/acs
2) SCIM will be owned by our platform team (cc'd is security@fieldbridge.com for visibility). We will provision email, displayName, title, department and groups. We need group -> role mapping; please indicate what role claims Redwood expects.
3) For callbacks we can start with these /24s: 34.72.12.0/24, 52.11.8.0/24. Admin console will be whitelisted to our corporate egress ranges (listed in the attached ip list).

Can Ben do Tuesday 10:00–10:30 PT? Our directory engineer (Jared) will join. On service accounts: we prefer short-lived keys. Do you support rotating service account credentials via our KMS?

Best,
Alice
Director, IT Security | Fieldbridge
alice.liu@fieldbridge.com

Quoted message:
> On Tue, 11 May 2027 at 09:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Liu <alice.liu@fieldbridge.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization & access governance — Launch plan for Fieldbridge onboarding

Hi Alice —

Tuesday 10:00 PT works for me. For the role claim mapping we typically accept an ISO-standard claim ("roles" or "groups") and then translate to per-tenant RBAC via our entitlement layer. I'll attach a sample mapping file in the call invite. Quick notes ahead of the call:
- SCIM scope: we'll request PATCH + GET for the enterprise user endpoints; we do not need full push of all profile attributes, just the set you listed.
- Service accounts: Redwood supports short-lived key exchange via customer KMS (we use an OIDC-based handshake to mint short-lived credentials for the runtime). If you want us to integrate with your KMS, we'll need an admin service principal from your side to accept the federation trust. If not, we can provision an internal rotating key and provide audit logs.
- IP allowlist: for callbacks we recommend pinning to /24s during initial testing and then narrowing after stable traffic.

Agenda for Tuesday (10:00 PT):
1) Quick IdP/ACS validation and metadata exchange
2) SCIM attribute mapping + group->role mapping expectations
3) Service account model and KMS handoff options
4) Next steps + timeline for staging cutover (we'll propose a canary window)

See you on Tuesday — invite sent.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Alice Liu <alice.liu@fieldbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fieldbridge.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization & access governance — Launch plan for Fieldbridge onboarding

Ben/Amanda (Soojin) —

Thanks for the call earlier. Jared confirmed the SCIM attributes and shared a small CSV with our groups. A couple of follow-ups from our side:
- Can you confirm which SCIM group external_id you will write to? We want to avoid collisions with our existing directory groups.
- For service account credential rotation: we prefer Redwood to call our KMS to mint ephemeral keys rather than long-lived secrets. Please send the minimal set of permissions your runtime needs for the KMS principal.
- Please provide a template for the IP allowlist CSV in the format we can import into our firewall appliance.

We reviewed the checklist you sent. We can target a staging cutover on 2027-05-25 with a production go-live the week after, pending a successful canary. Please confirm if that timeline works and whether Redwood needs any additional PO or paperwork.

Best,
Alice

On Thu, May 14, 2027 at 09:35 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the notes — we'll send a permissions manifest and an IP template by end of day.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Liu <alice.liu@fieldbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization & access governance — Launch plan for Fieldbridge onboarding

Hi Alice —

Sending the deliverables we discussed: attached IP allowlist template, SCIM -> Redwood attribute mapping (CSV), and a short service-account setup guide that lists the least-privilege permissions for KMS federation. Summary and next steps:
- Staging cutover scheduled 2027-05-25 09:00 PT (canary window 09:00–11:00 PT).
- Production go-live target 2027-06-01 pending canary metrics and security sign-off.
- Action items for Fieldbridge: upload test IdP metadata to the shared drive, create a KMS principal for Redwood federation with the attached permission set, import the IP CSV into your firewall.
- Action items for Redwood: we will enable SCIM in dry-run mode and not push deletes until you sign the final provisioning policy. We'll provide canary dashboards and revoke keys if anything looks off.

If you approve the above, I'll request the staging cutover ticket with engineering and CS to lock resources.

Thanks,
Soojin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ip-allowlist-template.csv, scim-attribute-mapping.csv, redwood-service-account-setup.pdf
